source.task_prompt: Write a function to check if all the elements in tuple have same data type or not.

generation.text:
```python
def check_type(t):
    """
    Check if all elements in the tuple have the same data type.

    Parameters:
    t (tuple): The tuple to check.

    Returns:
    bool: True if all elements have the same data type, False otherwise.
    """
    return all(isinstance(x, type(t[0])) for x in t)
```
